def test_is_happy():
    # Strings shorter than 3 characters are not happy
    assert is_happy("") == False
    assert is_happy("a") == False
    assert is_happy("aa") == False
    assert is_happy("ab") == False

    # Exactly 3 characters
    assert is_happy("abc") == True
    assert is_happy("adb") == True
    assert is_happy("xyy") == False
    assert is_happy("aab") == False
    assert is_happy("aaa") == False

    # Every window of 3 consecutive chars must be distinct
    assert is_happy("abcd") == True
    assert is_happy("aabb") == False
    assert is_happy("adbbd") == False
    assert is_happy("xyzy") == False

    # Longer strings
    assert is_happy("abcabc") == True
    assert is_happy("abcab") == True
    assert is_happy("abcba") == False
    assert is_happy("abcc") == False
    assert is_happy("abcdefg") == True
    assert is_happy("abcdeefg") == False

    # Case sensitivity: 'a' and 'A' are distinct characters
    assert is_happy("aAbB") == True
    assert is_happy("aAa") == False

    # Digits and mixed characters
    assert is_happy("123") == True
    assert is_happy("112") == False
    assert is_happy("1a2b3c") == True

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_is_happy()
